text:
Alex Rivera: Heads up — found multiple parity gaps between the REST API and the JS SDK while debugging a customer sample app. Missing/renamed params, streaming behaves differently, and retry/auth behavior isn't the same. Repro below.

Maya Singh: Can you paste a minimal repro and the SDK version?

Alex Rivera: Sample app is pinned to js-sdk v0.3.2. Quick repro: REST call that works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hi"}],"function_call":"none","stream":true}'
```
JS SDK attempt (v0.3.2) fails:
```js
client.chat.create({
  model: 'gpt-small',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Say hi'}],
  functionCall: 'none', // SDK expects camelCase
  stream: true
})
```
Response: 400 / unknown param `functionCall`. Also when `stream: true` SDK returns whole response once rather than streaming tokens.

Chen Wu: Hmm — docs are inconsistent. We have examples that use `function_call` (snake_case) in REST examples but older SDK examples show `functionCall`. That mismatch causes param drift. Also I noticed the SDK automatically retries 429/503 with exponential backoff but does not expose hooks to opt out — customers want deterministic behavior for streaming. :face_with_monocle:

Maya Singh: Is there an open issue for the param normalization? Might be simplest to add a normalizer in the SDK that maps both `functionCall` <-> `function_call` and `maxTokens` <-> `max_tokens` until we standardize.

Alex Rivera: Agreed. There's also an auth quirk: sample app uses env var REDWOOD_API_KEY and direct fetch to REST works. But SDK will attach an `x-api-key` header in some cases and `Authorization: Bearer` in others depending on runtime detection — that inconsistency breaks proxies and some VPC setups.

Sam Patel: We have issue #432 tracking param normalization, but it's scoped to python-sdk only. I'll open a parallel ticket for js-sdk and mark as priority. We should do two things: 1) Add a compatibility layer in the SDK (non-breaking), 2) Update quickstarts to use the canonical param names and an explicit example for streaming + function calling.

Chen Wu: BE careful with automatic retries for streaming requests — if we retry a streamed request the SDK could end up buffering tokens and re-emitting them, which confuses clients. Need an opt-in retry strategy for streaming endpoints.

Maya Singh: Proposal: 1) short-term mapper in SDK that accepts either casing, 2) expose retry hooks and a `retry: {mode: 'none'|'idempotent'|'all'}` option, 3) add e2e test in sample-app that asserts streaming yields incremental events. Any objections?

Alex Rivera: Sounds good. I'll draft a PR for the mapper + tests against the sample app. Will include a failing test showing current behavior.

dx-bot: Created ticket DE-2026: SDK param parity + streaming/retry differences — https://redwood-internal/issue/DE-2026

Sam Patel: Nice. @Alex @Maya please coordinate on test matrix. I'll grab the issue and assign follow-ups. :+1:

Maya Singh: Thanks — will add to next sprint and update quickstart docs after the mapper lands.

Alex Rivera: Thanks all — sending the failing logs and full stack trace in thread follow-up.
